de: French astronomer Jean-Louis Pons makes his first comet discovery. In the next 27 years he discovers another 36 comets, more than any other person in history.

t: 美国海军陆战队重新成立；他们在美国独立战争后被解散。
te: The United States Marine Corps is re-established; they had been disbanded after the American Revolutionary War.
dz: 美国海军陆战队重新成立；他们在美国独立战争后被解散。
de: The United States Marine Corps is re-established; they had been disbanded after the American Revolutionary War.

te: The United States takes possession of Detroit from Great Britain under terms of the Jay Treaty.
dz: 美国根据"杰伊条约"条款从英国手中夺取了底特律.

dz: 雅克·内克被解职,成为法国财政部长,点燃了"巴士底河风暴".

te: Mathematical calculations suggest that it is on this day that dwarf planet Pluto moved inside the orbit of Neptune for …
dz: 数学计算表明,正是在这一天,矮行星冥王星在1979年之前最后一次在海王星轨道内移动.
de: Mathematical calculations suggest that it is on this day that dwarf planet Pluto moved inside the orbit of Neptune for the last time before 1979.

te: A coalition army of Dutch, English and German troops under the duke of Marlborough defeats a French army under the duke…
dz: 马尔伯勒公爵手下由荷兰,英国和德军组成的联军在乌德纳尔德战役中击败了勃艮第公爵和文多姆元帅手下的一支法国军队.
de: A coalition army of Dutch, English and German troops under the duke of Marlborough defeats a French army under the duke of Burgundy and the Marshal Vendome in the battle of Oudenarde.

te: Samuel de Champlain returns to Quebec.
dz: 塞缪尔·德·尚普兰回魁北克.
de: Samuel de Champlain returns to Quebec.

t: 在探索北大西洋试图寻找西北航道时，马丁·弗罗比舍看到了格陵兰岛，并将其误认为是假设的（但不存在…
te: While exploring the North Atlantic Ocean in an attempt to find the Northwest Passage, Martin Frobisher sights Greenland…
dz: 在探索北大西洋试图寻找西北航道时，马丁·弗罗比舍看到了格陵兰岛，并将其误认为是假设的（但不存在的）“弗里斯兰”岛。
de: While exploring the North Atlantic Ocean in an attempt to find the Northwest Passage, Martin Frobisher sights Greenland, mistaking it for the hypothesized (but non-existent) island of "Frisland".

dz: Giuliano della Rovere 被任命为 Coutances 主教。

de: Ottoman Interregnum: Süleyman Çelebi defeats his brother Musa Çelebi outside the Ottoman capital, Edirne.

dz: 明朝海军上将郑和首次扬帆出海探索世界。

dz: 夏尔四世,卢森堡伯爵和波希米亚国王,被选为罗马人国王.

dz: 金口之战(荷兰语:Guldensporenslag): 围绕弗拉芒城市的联盟击败了法国国王的皇家军队.

t: 在当年早些时候的格雷戈里十世教皇去世后,在安茹的查理一世的影响下选举阿德里安五世为教皇. 阿德…
te: Election of pope Adrian V under the influence of Charles I of Anjou following the death of pope Gregory X earlier that …
dz: 在当年早些时候的格雷戈里十世教皇去世后,在安茹的查理一世的影响下选举阿德里安五世为教皇. 阿德里安五世于次月去世.
de: Election of pope Adrian V under the influence of Charles I of Anjou following the death of pope Gregory X earlier that year. Adrian V dies the following month.
